hook.text: A product page queries the database on every single visit. It gets 10,000 hits per minute. The DB groans.

buildup.text: Caching stores frequently accessed data in fast storage so the database doesn't repeat the same work.

discovery.text: Layers of caching—browser, CDN, application, database—each reduce load at a different level.

twist.text: Stale cache is dangerous. Showing outdated prices or sold-out inventory destroys user trust.

climax.text: A 60-second cache on product pages cuts database load by 95% with acceptable staleness.

punchline.text: Cache what's read often and changes rarely. Invalidate the rest.

quiz.question: What is the main risk of caching?
